description:
A security audit requires rotating the database credentials for the 'app-stack' running in Docker Compose at /home/ga/app-stack/. 

The current PostgreSQL password is 'oldpass123'. You must change it to 'SecureNewPass!2024'.

Requirements:
1. Update the running PostgreSQL database to use the new password (user: appuser).
2. Update the docker-compose.yml file so both the database and the Adminer service use the new password.
3. Ensure all services are restarted and running with the new configuration.
4. CRITICAL: The existing data (project records) must be PRESERVED. Do not delete the database volume.

Verify your work by ensuring Adminer (http://localhost:8081) can still connect to the database.
